name: multipliers-clamped-low
description: A 15 cm pot in direct light wants 0.4 of the catalogue interval; the clamp holds it to 0.6 and the clipped part moves into the amount: 0.6 / 0.4 = 1.5 times the water each time.
why: Clamp the product of the start multipliers to 0.6 to 1.6 but do not lose what the clamp removes. The pot would dry 0.4 of the interval; watering every 0.6 instead, each watering has to carry 0.6 / 0.4 of the usual water. Light direct 0.4, 15 cm 1.0, plastic 1.0. Hand computation.
